original_test_intent: Validate PCIe generation-speed interoperability across the mapped HGX path by exercising every approved NVQual Test #29 start-to-target generation transition and proving full-width link and NVIDIA function recovery without hang, unplanned reboot, or new errors.
original_method: Approve a capability-backed directed transition matrix, complete link path, expected width, start-state establishment, speed request, equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle deadline, iterations, final state and error criteria; preserve baselines; durably record each request and settled state before the next; stop on unsupported or failed transition and recover out of band.
manual_activity: HGX owner/FAE approves the capability-backed transition matrix, path, iterations and service impact; an operator isolates the SUT, watches out-of-band health, and owns recovery.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #29 speed-change package/configuration and compatible firmware/driver
Complete root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/per-lane generation and width capability map
Directed start-to-target matrix, start-state method, request/equalization/LTSSM/settle/deadline/transient rules
Iterations/timing, full device/function/error acceptance, final state, storage, aborts and recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production HGX SUT and explicit supported-transition authorization
Positive end-to-end capability proof before each pair; no unsaved workload; verified BMC/console recovery
Stop on unsupported request, failed/late transition, downtraining, missing/misbound device, driver/GPU failure, hang/reboot, new AER, thermal/power fault, tool failure or evidence gap
No forced mode, reset/power escalation, evidence clearing or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate Test #29 configuration, path capabilities, matrix, baseline, interlocks and recovery
Commit requested/observed start/target, equalization/LTSSM, generation/width, device/function and error evidence before the next transition
Do not infer capability, substitute a reverse pair, retry faults, force recovery or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Test #29 recipe, path/capability map, directed generation matrix and iterations
Define start-state, request, trajectory, settle/deadline, width, device/function and error acceptance
Review every transition and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It identifies generation changes but supplies no directed matrix or exact configuration; a final link snapshot cannot prove every requested start-to-target transition.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned Test #29 recipe with an atomic ledger and block transition N+1 until N's start state, target request, training path, settled generation/width, complete device/function state and error results are durable.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #29, PCIe generation speed-change interoperability, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/600-minute allocation remain; missing matrix and counts are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL MATRIX-DRIVEN HGX PCIE GENERATION INTEROPERABILITY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a capability-backed directed generation matrix and treat each pair as a transaction from proven start state through speed request and training to settled full-width device/function health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds directed pair coverage, capability proof, transaction evidence, first-fault inhibition, final-state ownership and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final fast link cannot reveal skipped pairs, reversed direction, unsupported requests, transient downtraining, failed intermediate equalization or recovered AER events.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Forcing an unsupported generation can destabilize the link, remove GPUs or hang the host; later successful transitions can hide the first failure.

project_override_considerations: Each directed pair is distinct coverage; A-to-B does not prove B-to-A. Vendor aggregate pass is acceptable only when the artifact exposes the configured matrix and every transaction result. Retrain-only, link toggle, SBR, reboot and power cycle are not substitutes.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #29 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus end-to-end generation/width/per-lane capability map
Approved directed matrix, start-state method, training/deadline/error/final-state rules and iterations
First-fault recovery or clean final link/device/host state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Test #29 Procedure, Criteria and same-row AI review consistently target generation-speed interoperability. The absent transition matrix is readiness under-specification, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The generation-change objective is clear. Proprietary tooling, capability-backed matrix, acceptance, isolation, evidence and recovery are identifiable prerequisites rather than permanent review blockers.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2132 Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00009-V002: approve the exact NVQual Test #29 configuration, root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/per-lane capability map, directed start-to-target generation/width matrix, start-state and request/equalization/LTSSM/settle/deadline rules, iterations, device/function and AER/error acceptance, final state, first-fault interlocks, and recovery.

review_improvement: Makes Test #29 a capability-backed directed matrix with auditable per-transition state, preventing a final high-speed snapshot or reverse transition from substituting for required coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Generation interoperability is directional because entering a start state and negotiating upward or downward can follow different equalization and firmware paths. End-to-end capability must include every intermediate component, not just endpoint capability. Each transition therefore needs proven start state, requested target and settled full-width evidence tied to stable device identity and error chronology before another request can overwrite the failure context.
